pageCache.text:
Nurturing potential for all within a Christian ethos
Welcome to St John's CofE Primary School
At St John's, we work to enable all children to achieve their full potential within our Christian family. We nurture individuality - providing challenge, developing self-esteem and promoting care and respect for each other and God’s world.
St John’s is a Church of England Primary School, located in the South Buckinghamshire village of Lacey Green. The school is at the heart of the community and plays a central role providing a high quality education for its pupils. We are linked to St John’s Church set opposite the school and this underpins our strong Christian ethos from which to carry out our vision: Nurturing Potential for all within a Christian Ethos. In February 2018, St John’s became a member of the Oxford Diocesan Bucks School Trust (ODBST), a multi academy trust.
Christian Vision and Associated Values
Be kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God, for Christ's sake hath forgiven you - Ephesians 4:32
Trust in the Lord, for the lord is everlasting strength - Isaiah 26:4
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, even as I have loved you, that you also love on another - John 13:34
Now the Lord of peace himself, give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all - Thessalonians 3:16
Show proper respect to everyone: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honour the king - 1 Peter 2:17
In everything give thanks: for this is the will of God - Thessalonians 5:18

Parents' Association
Welcome to the Parents Association!
St. John’s Parents Association is a registered charity run by parents and carers of children at St. John’s School. Every parent/carer at St. John’s is a member of the school Parents Association and ‘every little’ really does help. We are extremely fortunate to have such an active PA and whether you organise an event, bake a cake or buy a raffle ticket it helps to make a difference to ALL of the children. The money raised enables us to purchase lots of extras that the school budget simply cannot provide.
There will always be a ‘wish list’ from the school and our fundraising will be ongoing forever, but with such a great team of parents anything is possible and there’s plenty of fun to be had along the way!
If you have any suggestions for things we can buy with the money raised, events we can run to raise money, any ideas/comments then please do get in touch. If you don’t tell us we won’t know what you want!!
Thank you for all your support and we look forward to seeing you and your children at upcoming events.
Information on all events coming up can be found on our PA Website

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's CofE Primary School - SEND and Mental Health
pageCache.text:
SEND and Mental Health
Intent
At St John’s, all children are viewed as unique individuals. Where Barriers to learning exist, staff work together with pupils and parents to investigate and overcome barriers in a supportive way. We encourage and celebrate determination and effort; the enjoyment of discovery when meeting a range of challenges, working independently and collaboratively, all building resilience and positive approaches for the future. We are a fully inclusive and nurturing school where all children are welcomed.
St John's Church of England Primary School is committed to ensuring that every child is provided with high quality teaching, matched carefully to the needs of all children, and an exciting, broad and balanced curriculum which offers academic rigour and creativity. As a Church of England school, we place a huge emphasis upon developing our learners’ spiritual, moral and social understanding.
All staff at St John's Church of England Primary School are inclusive practitioners and as part of our ongoing assessments, we carefully track the progress of every child and provide support where necessary. However, sometimes a child may require further additional support to enable them to make progress. How this is decided and what we can offer as a school is detailed in our school’s Special Educational Needs and Disabilities Policy.

Sports Premium
The primary PE and sport premium was introduced in March 2013 to improve the provision of physical education and school sport in primary schools across England. The funding is allocated directly to primary schools and is ring-fenced. This means it may only be spent on improving the provision of PE and sport in schools.

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's CofE Primary School - Parents Evening Booking
pageCache.text:
Parents Evening Booking
Your Account Details
We will initially generate an account for you using the email address you have provided to the school for communications. When we do this, you will receive an email inviting you to create a password for your account.
If you have not received the message, check your junk/spam folder and ensure that you have added support.jw@junipereducation.org to your safe senders list.
Logging in
You can access our booking system at any time using this link:
You will be prompted to log in by entering your email address and password. If you have not yet set your password, you can request a password reset email by clicking ‘Forgot your password’. You should use the email address you have registered with the school.
Making a Booking
The child you are booking for will show in the top right-hand corner of the screen. If you have more than one child at our school, you will see a circle for each child. Simply click on the relevant circle to select the child you want to make a booking for.
Find the teacher and time you’d like to book and click to reserve the time slot. The selection will show in green with the word “RESERVED”. The time allocated for each slot will be automatically populated.
Please note: the slot will only be reserved for 10 minutes.
To confirm the reservation you’ll need to click on the save button in the bottom right corner.
